source: Mixed oracle: original private DLL execution for empty lane lists; automatically source-extracted original C# methods for populated typed lookups. Not a full Unity ECS runtime.

adapterChanges: NativeList<Entity> replaced by List-derived typed LaneList<Entity> with Length property
m_LaneSignalData uses Dictionary<Entity, original Game.Net.LaneSignal> instead of ECS ComponentLookup
IsEmpty is explicit callback; bridge/vehicle physical occupancy intentionally not reproduced here
Original Game structs, enums and Unity.Mathematics.math remain DLL references
